name: prd-generator
description: Generate FAANG-quality PRDs from rough notes, with AI-refinable sections and honest gap-flagging instead of invented numbers.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
